# Justin He

> Portfolio and personal website of Justin He

## Blog

- [Leaving Tech Job for New Ventures](https://www.justinhe.com/blog/creating-a-home-on-the-internet): Personal essay about quitting corporate job to pursue entrepreneurial ambitions and build something meaningful.

## Other

- [Claude Surf AI Development Tool](https://www.justinhe.com/projects/project-claude-surf): Orchestrator for Claude Code that automates software development with agents and workflows
- [Color Theory Fundamentals](https://www.justinhe.com/a): Practice note on color wheels, harmony schemes, perceptual color spaces, and design principles.
- [History of Martian Ideas](https://www.justinhe.com/b): Two centuries of human imagination about Martians, from canal theories to modern spacecraft discoveries.
- [The Shipping Container](https://www.justinhe.com/c): How standardized steel containers revolutionized global trade and enabled modern globalization economics.
- [Sourdough Science and Practice](https://www.justinhe.com/d): Comprehensive guide to sourdough starter microbiology, fermentation chemistry, and baking techniques explained.
- [Ancient Eclipse-Predicting Mechanism](https://www.justinhe.com/e): Ancient Greek geared calculator from 150-100 BCE that predicted eclipses and tracked celestial cycles.
- [Songbird Vocal Learning Mechanisms](https://www.justinhe.com/f): How songbirds learn to sing through critical periods, auditory feedback, and neural circuits analogous to human speech.
- [Map Projections Explained](https://www.justinhe.com/g): Why every flat map distorts Earth, what projections preserve, and why Web Mercator dominates online mapping.
- [Bioluminescence Chemistry and Biology](https://www.justinhe.com/h): Explores cold light chemistry, evolutionary adaptations, camouflage strategies, and scientific discoveries in deep-sea organisms.
- [Roman Concrete Durability](https://www.justinhe.com/i): Why Roman concrete structures survived millennia while modern concrete fails faster due to superior volcanic ash composition and self-healing properties.
